label: Paper Collage
principles: Use recognizable real photographs, authentic documents, logos and real footage; keep provenance.
Build the real hook first and obtain the user's decision before propagating the look.
Animate the relationship being narrated; give objects meaningful changes after their entrance.
Select paper, text and emphasis colors from the client's verified brand; preserve resource colors.
Keep speaker presence, caption treatment and platform margins specific to this recording.
Inspect the changed scene and its joins first; widen review only for shared causes.
reference: 2026-10-cvander-univguate/edicion/pipeline.json (aprobado por Chris 5-oct; antes apuntaba a cvandersep2, sin aprobación registrada)
